config.monkeycraft.title: MonkeyCraft Configuration
config.monkeycraft.option.autoLaunch.too: Automatically start the WebSocket server when joining a game
config.monkeycraft.option.showQrCodeWhen: Show QR code when auto-launching the server. When disabled, the server starts without displaying the QR code
config.monkeycraft.option.port.tooltip: The port number for the MonkeyCraft server (1-65535)
config.monkeycraft.option.networkScope.t: Which devices may connect to the server. Tailscale is configured separately below.
config.monkeycraft.option.networkScope.a: WARNING: 'Anyone' lets any host that can reach this port attempt to connect. Only the password protects you, and traffic is not encrypted on the wire. Prefer 'My local network' unless you understand the risk.
config.monkeycraft.option.tailscaleAcces: Whether to accept connections from your Tailscale network (the 100.64.0.0/10 range), in addition to the scope above.
Tailscale not detected on this PC
monkeycraft.server.allow_anywhere_warnin: WARNING: 'Who Can Connect' is set to Anyone. Anyone who can reach this port and knows the password can control your game.
monkeycraft.connection.rejected_possibly: Rejected a connection from %s (possibly Tailscale). Tailscale was not detected on this PC. Set Tailscale Access to 'Always allow' in /monkey config to allow it.
config.monkeycraft.option.password.toolt: Password for authentication (leave empty to keep current)
config.monkeycraft.option.commandAllowli: List of allowed command patterns. Use '*' for wildcard (e.g., 'warp *' allows '/warp anything'). Note: Other mods may additionally allow or restrict commands.
config.monkeycraft.option.commandDenylis: List of denied command patterns. Use '*' for wildcard (e.g., 'op *' denies '/op anyone'). Deny takes priority over allow. Note: Other mods may additionally allow or restrict commands.
config.monkeycraft.option.defaultBehavio: What to do when a command is not in allowlist or denylist. Use 'ALLOW' or 'DENY'
config.monkeycraft.option.alwaysAutoJump: Force auto-jump ON when a remote client is connected (useful for touch controls)
config.monkeycraft.option.startServerAtL: Start the MonkeyCraft server as soon as Minecraft finishes loading, so the app can connect and pick a server from the title screen. The server stays running across worlds.
config.monkeycraft.option.allowRemoteSer: Allow the connected app to make this client join a multiplayer server. Disable to reject remote join requests.
monkeycraft.server.port_unavailable: Port %s is unavailable. Server not started.
monkeycraft.command.help:
/monkey start - Start server
/monkey stop - Stop server
/monkey config - Open settings
/monkey ip - Show local IPs
